verdict.rationale: E2B docs explicitly document files.read(), files.write() (including multi-file writes), and files.list() methods via the SDK for the sandbox filesystem, covering read/write/list operations clearly. Upload/download is implied via files.write/read but not explicitly named as 'upload/download' terminology, though functionally equivalent. Missing for 10: explicit dedicated 'upload'/'download' API naming or independent hands-on confirmation beyond docs.
